# myArc

> A pre-release open-source browser project inspired by Arc, built on Chromium with a Rust-owned workspace core.

A complete myArc browser remains unimplemented, and the Arc importer brings over only Spaces and pinned tabs. Native integration is experimental. Arc reference screenshots illustrate the target appearance. Local ownership and optional AI are product requirements, not evidence of a finished release.

## Project

- [Overview](https://myarc.dev/index.md): Markdown equivalent of the homepage.
- [Progress journal](https://myarc.dev/blog/index.md): Published development updates.
- [Download](https://myarc.dev/download/index.md): Alpha nightly status, requirements and known limitations.
- [Repository](https://github.com/bitbonsai/myarc): Public source and plans.

## Docs

- [Docs index](https://myarc.dev/docs/index.md): User guides for people moving from Arc.
- [Install myArc](https://myarc.dev/docs/install/index.md): What your Mac needs, what macOS asks on first launch, the welcome tour, and how myArc moves to a newer nightly.
- [Import from Arc](https://myarc.dev/docs/import-from-arc/index.md): Import your Spaces, folders, pinned tabs and Favorites from Arc's sidebar file or its export, preview what myArc will add, and import again without duplicates.
- [Spaces and Profiles](https://myarc.dev/docs/spaces-and-profiles/index.md): How Spaces, Profiles, pinned tabs, Favorites and temporary tabs fit together in the myArc sidebar.
- [Peek](https://myarc.dev/docs/peek/index.md): How links from pinned tabs and Favorites open in a preview over the page, and how to keep, split, reopen or turn off that preview.
- [Keyboard shortcuts](https://myarc.dev/docs/shortcuts/index.md): The shortcuts that work in myArc today, and the Arc shortcuts that are still missing.
- [Your data](https://myarc.dev/docs/your-data/index.md): Where myArc keeps your workspace on disk, how to back it up, and what it sends over the network. There is no account.
- [Ad blocking](https://myarc.dev/docs/ad-blocking/index.md): How myArc blocks ads and trackers, and how to turn blocking off or on for one site.
- [CLI and MCP](https://myarc.dev/docs/cli-and-mcp/index.md): Drive myArc from a script or an AI agent with the bundled myarc command and its MCP server. It's off by default, and tab commands reach only the Agent Space.
- [Known limitations](https://myarc.dev/docs/known-limitations/index.md): What the alpha nightly can't do yet, and what to do after a crash or when something breaks.

## Posts

- [A thousand tabs, and agents that can see](https://myarc.dev/blog/thousand-tabs/index.md): Every alpha check is done against the real notarized app. Agents can now take screenshots, scroll, and wait for pages to load, and myArc handled a thousand tabs without flinching.
- [Alpha is here!!! 🎉](https://myarc.dev/blog/glass-and-extensions/index.md): myArc alpha is here. Settings is cleaner, the welcome screen only shows what your Mac can do, frosted glass covers every window, and pinned extension icons sit in the URL pill on hover.
- [A proper welcome](https://myarc.dev/blog/a-proper-welcome/index.md): myArc now says hello before your first tab. The screen dims, a soft blob of colour grows into a window, and a short tour has you try the basics on the real browser.
- [Keeping Arc's ideas going](https://myarc.dev/blog/keeping-arcs-ideas-going/index.md): Arc shuts down on December 22. myArc now has Peek, Split View and Little Arc, blocks ads from the first page, and opens on a Mac like any other app.
- [Letting agents use myArc](https://myarc.dev/blog/agents-use-myarc/index.md): The agents that build myArc can now use it, in a Space of their own and only after you say yes. Getting there turned up a bug in Chromium and a sidebar full of gray globes.
- [One window, two profiles](https://myarc.dev/blog/one-window-two-profiles/index.md): myArc now has real Profiles, so Work and Personal keep their own cookies and logins. Getting them to live in one window, the way Arc did, took more than I expected.
- [Taking a few patches from ungoogled-chromium](https://myarc.dev/blog/ungoogled-chromium/index.md): myArc now borrows four build flags and five patches from ungoogled-chromium. I left out the patches that would cost myArc more than they give, like the ones that break the Chrome Web Store.
- [Chasing Arc's details](https://myarc.dev/blog/closer-to-arc/index.md): Side-by-side recordings showed what myArc's sidebar was missing, and a quit bug was emptying every Space. Next up is an alpha checklist.
- [Why myArc is now GPL-3.0](https://myarc.dev/blog/gpl/index.md): myArc moved from the MIT license to GPL-3.0 so it stays open for good. I don't plan to make money from it, and any modified version has to publish its code.
- [Building myArc in public](https://myarc.dev/blog/building-in-public/index.md): Why I'm building myArc after Arc's sunset announcement, with account-free browsing, no behavioral tracking and an Artcraft-inspired workflow.
